_description: Per-type beginning-of-year balance fields (boyBalanceTraditional/Roth/Brokerage/Cash). Degenerate: 0% returns, 0% cash yield, 0% inflation, 0% LTCG, no ordinary tax ever (Traditional never touched). Two spending goals drain Cash then Brokerage through the withdrawal waterfall, so each account type's BOY balance is exactly traceable by hand.
_rationale: Trad $300k / Brokerage $200k / Cash $50k, single, Florida. Spending: $30k/yr living (age 60+) plus $10k/yr healthcare (ages 60-62) = $40k for 3 years, then $30k. Waterfall pulls Cash first, then Brokerage. With all returns, yield, inflation, and cap-gains at 0 and Traditional untouched (no RMD before 73, horizon ends at 66), every year's per-type BOY balance is prior BOY minus prior withdrawals: cash 50k->10k->0; brokerage 200k (y0-1) ->170k->130k->100k->70k->40k; traditional flat 300k; roth 0. The four fields must sum to the path value every year.
name: BOY Balance By Type
